
sql:
SELECT 
    p.Publisher,
    COUNT(*) AS Book_Count
FROM 
    book_club bc
JOIN 
    movie m ON bc.book_club_id = m.movie_id
JOIN 
    culture_company cc ON bc.book_club_id = cc.book_club_id
GROUP BY 
    p.Publisher
ORDER BY 
    Book_Count DESC
LIMIT 1
text:
</think>

```sql
SELECT 
    p.Publisher,
    COUNT(*) AS Book_Count
FROM 
    book_club bc
JOIN 
    movie m ON bc.book_club_id = m.movie_id
JOIN 
    culture_company cc ON bc.book_club_id = cc.book_club_id
GROUP BY 
    p.Publisher
ORDER BY 
    Book_Count DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

FROM technician t

JOIN machine m ON ra.Machine_ID = m.Machine_ID
GROUP BY t.technician_id

</think>

```sql
SELECT t.Name, COUNT(m.Machine_ID) AS Machine_Count
FROM technician t
JOIN repair_assignment ra ON t.technician_id = ra.technician_id
JOIN machine m ON ra.Machine_ID = m.Machine_ID
GROUP BY t.technician_id;
```

    c.building,
    c.room_number,
    c.semester,
    c.year,
    c.title
FROM 
    classroom c
JOIN 
    department d ON c.building = d.building AND c.room_number = d.room_number
JOIN 
    course c ON c.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN 
    section s ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND s.semester = s.semester AND s.year = s.year
JOIN 
    teaches t ON s.course_id = t.course_id AND s.semester = t.semester AND s.year = t.year
JOIN 
    instructor i ON t.ID = i.ID
WHERE 
    d.dept_name = 'Psychology'
ORDER BY 
    c.title

```sql
    c.building,
    c.room_number,
    c.semester,
    c.year,
    c.title
FROM 
    classroom c
JOIN 
    department d ON c.building = d.building AND c.room_number = d.room_number
JOIN 
    course c ON c.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN 
    section s ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND s.semester = s.semester AND s.year = s.year

    teaches t ON s.course_id = t.course_id AND s.semester = t.semester AND s.year = t.year
```

LIMIT 1
